events.title: Tiri: Te Araroa Woman Far Walking BRISBANE FESTIVAL
events.description: Woven into a deeply emotional tapestry celebrating wāhine Māori and the emergent rangatahi who will take Aotearoa forward, Witi Ihimaera’s extraordinary play will shine once again in this astonishing new production.

events.title: Fashion Queensland in Conversation: Fashioning Brisbane: The Future of Fashion and Cultural Identity in our City
events.description: As Brisbane prepares for a defining decade, what role will fashion play in shaping the city's cultural identity? Join Fashion Queensland for an inspiring evening of conversation exploring the intersection of fashion, creativity, design, storytelling and placemaking, and the influence fashion has on how a city is experienced, remembered and celebrated.
